title: Concept: File scheme echoed in a response
description: A file URL in the body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A file URL in an error shows the handler accepts a scheme it should never resolve, which is the pattern an attacker pushes toward an arbitrary file read.
applicability: Deployments that render a file URL in the body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A file URL in an error shows the handler accepts a scheme it should never resolve, which is the pattern an attacker pushes toward an arbitrary file read.
